ops.old: Crisp corn, zucchini and herb fritters fried golden, with whipped feta and lemon for dolloping on top. Grate 2 zucchini, salt for 10 minutes and squeeze dry. Mix with 200g corn kernels, 2 spring onions, mint, 100g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 50g crumbled feta. Shallow-fry spoonfuls in hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes a side. Blitz 150g feta with 80g Greek yoghurt and lemon zest and serve on the side.
